reason: Two layer-1 native evaluations reported infrastructure failure and reclassified all 37 collected tests as Core, producing a non-canonical test hash. The run was stopped during layer 2 and no control arm was completed.
remediation: The MiniSWE backend now treats infrastructure failure, Core-total drift, and frozen test-hash drift as rejection conditions and automatically evaluates the same snapshot in an isolated clean evaluator before deciding source eligibility.
